title: Collusion-proof Auction Design using Side Information
abstract: arXiv:2511.12456v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bidder collusion degrades welfare and fairness in standard auctions. To address this, we introduce the Conditional-Posted Price (C-PoP) mechanism, a collusion-resilient design that uses machine learning classifiers to predict, even imprecisely, which bidders are colluding. C-PoP computes Posted Prices conditioned on predicted non-colluders' bids, ensuring truthfulness under perfect classification, thereby improving fairness toward non-colluders. Under imperfect classification, we bound overall and non-colluder welfare to establish the mechanism's robustness and fairness, respectively. Crucially, these bounds provide insights for classifier design, revealing that false negatives (misclassifying colluders as non-colluders) are preferable to false positives (misclassifying non-colluders as colluders). translated_title: 利用侧信息的抗串谋拍卖设计
translated_abstract: 在标准拍卖中，投标人之间的串谋行为会损害社会福利与公平性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了条件定价机制——这是一种抗串谋的拍卖设计，它利用机器学习分类器来预测哪些投标人正在串谋，即使这种预测并不精确。C-PoP基于预测出的非串谋者的报价来计算公示价格，在分类完全准确的情况下确保了机制的真实性，从而提升了对非串谋者的公平性。在分类不完美的情况下，我们给出了总体福利和非串谋者福利的界限，分别确立了该机制的稳健性与公平性。至关重要的是，这些界限为分类器设计提供了洞见：假阴性（将串谋者误判为非串谋者）优于假阳性（将非串谋者误判为串谋者）。数值实验表明，即使在分类不完美的情况下，C-PoP在存在串谋时仍能在福利、收入和公平性方面取得优异表现。
tldr: 提出条件定价（C-PoP）拍卖机制，利用机器学习分类器预测串谋投标人并据此设定条件价格，即使分类不完美也能保证机制的稳健性与公平性，并揭示了分类器设计应更容忍假阴性而非假阳性的关键洞见。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Conditional-Posted Price (C-PoP) mechanism, which uses machine learning classifiers to predict colluding bidders and sets posted prices conditioned on non-colluders' bids, ensuring truthfulness under perfect classification and robust welfare and fairness under imperfect classification, revealing that false negatives are preferable to false positives in classifier design.
